name: owned-profile-bootstrap
goal: Profile project source when the adapter and forwarded schema are inside that same project

evidence: Main relocates the unit schema behind its public forwarding entry. The preload only bypasses that old entry and may recursively await its own adapter while loading the real schema.

Normal lifecycle fixtures put the profiling adapter outside their selected project root. Add the missing own-project case using the real forwarded schema, actual route operation and retained runtime observations.
